node.title: Re^3: Capture STDOUT and send to screen with open3
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Capture::Tiny is not available for install w/o cpan on Oracle Linux

You don't need cpan, does the manual installation procedure not work?

$ wget http://search.cpan.org/CPAN/authors/id/D/DA/DAGOLDEN/Capture-Tiny-0.46.tar.gz $ tar zxvf Capture-Tiny-0.46.tar.gz $ cd Capture-Tiny-0.46 $ perl Makefile.PL $ make $ make test $ make install

Or perhaps [mod://App::cpanminus|cpanm]:

$ curl -L https://cpanmin.us | perl - App::cpanminus $ cpanm Capture::Tiny
